source_caption:
🎥🎬: Fightland (2026)

Fightland follows a cast of fighters, promoters, and power players caught in the dangerous world of underground combat, where every match is about more than just winning. Reputation, loyalty, and survival are constantly on the line.

As old rivalries intensify and new threats emerge, every character is forced to navigate a world where trust is fleeting and every decision carries consequences. The battles outside the ring become just as important as the ones inside it.

Packed with hard-hitting action and gripping drama, Fightland explores what people are willing to risk when pride, family, and power collide.

#Fightland #STARZ #ActionDrama #CrimeSeries #UndergroundFighting

source_details.title: Fightland
source_details.synopsis: Fightland is a boxing crime drama television series created by Daniel Fajemisin-Duncan, Marlon Smith, Damione Macedon and Raphael Jackson Jr.. It premiered on July 31, 2026, on Starz in the United States and August 27, 2026, on Sky Atlantic in the United Kingdom.
